subject: general
question: As per NITI Aayog National Multidimensional Poverty Index - 2021, which state is the poorest?
solution:
The correct answer is ' **Bihar'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihar **has emerged as India's poorest , with half of its population** (51.91 percent)** living in below poverty line.
 
• This state has a** poverty rate of about 33.74 %.**
 
• **Kerala , Goa , and Sikkim** have the** lowest percentage** of the **population being multidimensionally poor.**
 
• This base line report of the national MPI measure is based on the** reference period of 2015-16 **of the** National Family Health Survey (NFHS). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** NITI Aayog National Multidimensional Poverty Index:**

 
 
• Its objective is to measure **poverty across its multiple dimensions** .**​**
 
• In effect completes **existing poverty statistics based on per capita consumption expenditure.**
 
• India's national MPI measures the** globally accepted** and **robust methodology developed by the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)** and** United Nations Development Program (UNDP)** which publishes the global Multidimensional Poverty Index.
